in_sanskrit.name: Bansal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ban (lord) + sal (mountain)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bansal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bansal is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ban’ meaning lord and ‘Sal’ meaning mountain. This name signifies a powerful and strong individual, just like a lord of a mountain.

in_marathi.name: Bansal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bansal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bansal is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Ban’ meaning lord and ‘Sal’ meaning mountain. This name signifies a powerful and strong individual, just like a lord of a mountain.
